_comment: Current /infer request schema per ROBOT_API_PICK_POSE_INTERFACE.md / ROBOT_API_HANDOFF.md. Keys starting with `_` are documentation only and must be removed (or ignored) before sending; never send literal `<...>` placeholders.
_example_sku: This file uses an Avene-shaped request. Change sku_id (and side for estee/origins) to match the job.

_notes.target_type: Required. `sku` = locate a product. `basket` is reserved and currently rejected with an unsupported error.
_notes.sku_id: Required. One of `Avene`, `estee`, `origins`. The service selects the recognition + geometry strategy from this value.
_notes.side: Conditional. For estee/origins use `LEFT` or `RIGHT` to pick the image-left/right box of the selected pair. Avene may send it but the direct flow records `side_applied=false`.
_notes.rgb_base64: Required. Base64 of the JPG/PNG file BYTES (not pixel arrays). Keep RGB, depth, K and T from the same capture.
_notes.depth_npy_base64: Required. Base64 of the full 2-D float32 aligned-depth .npy file bytes; values already in mm.
_notes.depth_unit: Required. Must be exactly `mm`; the service never rescales depth internally.
_notes.K: Required 3x3 pinhole intrinsics matching the current RGB resolution and projection model. `fx`/`fy` must be > 0.
_notes.T_chassis_camera: Required 4x4 row-major transform, p_chassis = R @ p_camera + t, for THIS frame. Rotation orthonormal, det ~= 1, last row [0,0,0,1].
_notes.T_unit: Required. Unit of the translation column only: `m` or `mm`. Here `m`.
_notes.front_rule: Conditional (chassis frame). front_axis_chassis + front_origin_chassis + front_band_mm. Used for Avene front-row selection and for box-first product front/back filtering plus front-panel fit.
_notes.front_rule.front_axis_chassis: Unit-ish direction of the chassis 'front' axis. Must be confirmed on site; in the 125311198 fixture [1,0,0] matched the measured front-panel normal while [0,1,0] was rejected by the normal prior.
_notes.front_rule.front_origin_chassis: Chassis-space origin of the front band. Site-specific; the zeros here are a placeholder.
_notes.front_rule.front_band_mm: Half-width of the kept band: keep |dot(p_chassis - origin, axis)| <= band. 100000 is a link-test band that filters almost nothing; it is NOT a validated production parameter.

_real_intrinsics_frame_120045958: The K and T below are the verified values of historical frame 120045958. They are valid numbers but belong to that frame only; real runs must substitute the current frame's K and T.

_optional_overrides.class_name: Legacy compatibility field; if sent it must equal sku_id.
_optional_overrides.sam3_prompt: Override the product-stage SAM3 prompt; default comes from the SKU class config.
_optional_overrides.box_selection: estee/origins only: {enabled, target_box, box_prompt, box_threshold, target_threshold, inference_mode, min_inside_ratio, crop_padding_px}. Omit for class defaults; `inference_mode` is `full_image_filter` (default) or `crop_box`.
_optional_overrides.z_ref_mm: Avene only: chassis Z plane for the reference point. Default 1200, a test plane, not a grasp height.
_optional_overrides.body_radius_mm: Avene only: fitted cylinder radius. Default 28.5; valid for the straight body only, not cap/shoulder.
